Costello syndrome (CS) is a RASopathy caused by activating germline mutations in HRAS.

Individuals with CS may have distinctive craniofacial features, cardiac anomalies, growth and developmental delays, as well as dermatological, orthopedic, ocular, and neurological issues; however, considerable overlap with other RASopathies exists.
